title: Compatible global scalars on the underived ringed pro-etale adjoint pair
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative ring, $u:U\to V$ a morphism of schemes, and use small pro-etale sites in the module-sheaf universe. Let $R_V,R_U$ be sheaves of commutative rings on these sites and $c:u^{-1}R_V\xrightarrow{\sim}R_U$ a specified coefficient identification. Let $a_T:A\to\Gamma(T,R_T)$ for $T=U,V$ be ring homomorphisms; write $a_T(a)|_W$ for the corresponding section at a site object $W$. Suppose the ring map $\rho:R_V\to u_*R_U$ adjoint to $c$ satisfies $\rho_W(a_V(a)|_W)=a_U(a)|_{U\times_V W}$ for every $a\in A$ and every site object $W$ over $V$. Use the actual underived module-sheaf adjunction $P=u^*\dashv G=u_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Give module-sheaf Hom groups the sectionwise action $(a h)_W(x)=a_T(a)|_W\,h_W(x)$, obtained by restriction of the global-section action [def-pur-sheaf-modules-hom-module]. These actions make both module-sheaf categories $A$-linear [def-weil-linear-category], and both $P$ and $G$ are additive $A$-linear functors [def-weil-linear-functor]: for each $F=P,G$, all parallel module-sheaf morphisms $h,k$ and all $a\in A$, $F(h+k)=F(h)+F(k)$ and $F(ah)=aF(h)$. No constancy, finiteness or injectivity condition on the ring maps $a_T$ is assumed.
